DE-DOCNUM-VISIBLE-9-ALNUM.description: German passport / Personalausweis document number — 9 alphanumeric characters, ICAO mod-10 check digit. Letters I and O are avoided to prevent ambiguity with 1 and 0.

DE-STEUER-ID-MOD-11-10.description: German Steuer-IdNr. 11 digits. First digit non-zero. In first 10 digits exactly one digit appears 2 or 3 times; remaining digits each appear at most once. 11th digit is ISO 7064 MOD 11,10 check.

ICAO-MRZ-TD3.description: ICAO TD3 (passport) — 2 lines × 44 chars. Per-field check digits + composite check digit.

ICAO-MRZ-TD1.description: ICAO TD1 (ID card) — 3 lines × 30 chars. Per-field check digits + composite check digit.

DE-DRIVING-LICENCE-PUBLIC-SURFACE.description: German driving licence (Führerschein) — field 5 licence number. No public checksum is published. Structure-only validation; deeper checks return not_checked.
